settings.siteTitle: Flight Sports Academy | Youth Sports in San Antonio, TX
settings.metaDescription: Youth sports academy in San Antonio, TX. Motor development for ages 2–6 and soccer, flag football and athletic training for ages 7+. Book a trial class.

hero.eyebrow: Youth sports academy · San Antonio, TX
hero.title: Kids who can't wait to come back tomorrow.
hero.subtitle: We build confident, resilient, kind and disciplined kids through sport — from first steps in motor skills at age 2 to sport-specific training in soccer and flag football.

mission.quote: Success isn't measured by how many goals kids score. It's measured by how many kids want to come back tomorrow.
mission.quoteSpanish: El éxito de hoy no se mide por cuántos goles anotaron los niños. Se mide por cuántos niños quieren volver mañana.

programs.title: Two paths. One way of training.

tracks.headline: Specialists in motor development and sport fundamentals
tracks.text: Fun first. Kids build coordination, balance and body confidence through games — and learn to listen, take turns and try again.

items.name: Motor Skills
items.text: Small morning groups focused on movement foundations. 1x or 2x per week; limited spots.

items.name: Movement & Play
items.text: Plyometrics, hand-eye coordination games and bodyweight work. Fun, dynamic, and it keeps kids wanting more.

tracks.headline: Specialized training by sport
tracks.text: Results-focused coaching for kids who want to get better at their sport and compete — with the same focus on discipline and teamwork.

items.name: Soccer Academy
items.text: Technique, game sense and match play.

items.name: Football Academy
items.text: Routes, throwing, flag pulling and team plays.

items.name: Athletic Development
items.text: High-intensity work with rest to build explosiveness, strength and conditioning. For kids serious about sports.

schedule.title: Monday to Thursday
schedule.note: Evening classes run 1 hour. Motor Skills groups (A–D) are 30 minutes, ages 2–4.

pricing.title: Simple monthly membership
pricing.intro: Choose how many classes per week. Membership renews automatically each month. Applies to Movement & Play, Sports Academy and Athletic Development.

extras.title: Registration · $150
extras.text: One-time. Includes the required uniform: 1 pair of shorts, 2 shirts and 1 pair of socks.

extras.title: Sibling discount
extras.text: 2nd child 10% off. 3rd child and up 25% off.

extras.title: No membership
extras.text: Pay-as-you-go: 1 class $150 · 2 classes $250 · 3 classes $300. No unlimited option.

pricing.note: Motor Skills (ages 2–4) is available 1x or 2x per week only, due to limited group size.

about.title: Meet Coach Marcelo
about.bio:
[Coach bio: background, coaching experience, why he started Flight Sports Academy.]

Our philosophy is simple: retention over winning. A child who loves coming back keeps growing — in skill, in confidence and in character. Every class is designed so kids leave tired, proud and excited for the next one.

principles.title: Fun keeps them coming
principles.text: Games and challenges, not drills for drills' sake.

principles.title: Structure builds discipline
principles.text: Clear routines and respect in every session.

items.question: What age can my child start?
items.answer: From age 2. Motor Skills is for ages 2–4, Movement & Play for younger kids, and sport-specific programs for ages 7+.

items.question: How does the trial class work?
items.answer: Pick the class you'd like to try below. We'll confirm by WhatsApp or phone and your child joins a regular session.

items.question: Is a uniform required?
items.answer: Yes. The uniform set is included with the $150 registration fee.

items.question: How do payments work?
items.answer: After the trial we send you a secure payment link. Memberships are billed automatically every month.

items.question: Do you offer sibling discounts?
items.answer: Yes — 10% off the 2nd child and 25% off the 3rd child and up.
